context: A mom consults a doctor about general family health concerns
purpose: Teach: インフルエンザ/アルコール/脂肪/推定/進展/重点/喫煙/美しく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 先生、今年もインフルエンザの流行が心配で、家族全員の健康診断をお願いしたいんです。
lines.en: Doctor, I'm worried about this year's flu outbreak, so I'd like a health check for the whole family.
lines.style: Concerned mother opening with polite consultative tone

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: もちろんです。まずはご主人のことから伺いましょうか。喫煙やお酒の習慣はいかがですか。
lines.en: Of course. Let's start with your husband. How are his smoking and drinking habits?
lines.style: Calm professional doctor inviting detailed background

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それが悩みで、夫の喫煙は全然減らず、毎晩アルコールの強いお酒ばかり飲んでいて…。
lines.en: That's my worry — his smoking hasn't decreased at all, and every night he drinks only strong alcoholic drinks.
lines.style: Sighing wife confiding domestic health concern naturally

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。前回の数値から推定すると、中性脂肪がかなり上昇している可能性が高いですね。
lines.en: I see. Estimating from his last numbers, his triglycerides are likely climbing significantly.
lines.style: Measured doctor delivering clinical inference carefully

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: やっぱり…。生活改善の話は何度もしたのですが、なかなか進展しなくて。
lines.en: I knew it... We've talked about lifestyle changes many times, but there's been little progress.
lines.style: Resigned mother expressing prolonged household frustration clearly

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: では今回は食事と運動の二点に重点を置いて、ご家族で取り組むプランを立てましょう。
lines.en: Then this time let's focus on diet and exercise, building a plan the whole family follows together.
lines.style: Encouraging doctor pivoting toward actionable strategy

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 血管も美しく保つには、奥様やお子様の食習慣も一緒に見直すのが一番効果的ですよ。
lines.en: To keep the blood vessels healthy and clean too, reviewing your and your child's eating habits together is most effective.
lines.style: Doctor broadening scope to whole-family habits warmly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがたいです。家族みんなで取り組めば、夫も少しは本気になってくれそうな気がします。
lines.en: I appreciate that. If we all work on it as a family, I feel my husband might finally take it seriously.
lines.style: Hopeful mother finding renewed motivation together

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それは何よりです。では来週、ご家族そろってお越しください。詳しい検査をご案内します。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Please come together as a family next week, and I'll guide you through the detailed exams.
lines.style: Warm doctor closing with reassuring next steps
